task_objective: Summarize an AI-assisted evidence package while distinguishing supported claims, unsupported production-quality claims and explicit limitations.

text_first_baseline.input_summary: Broad text bundle from evidence notes, smoke outputs, review comments and implementation summaries.

gates: evidence type must support the claim
unsupported production-quality claims must be flagged
review findings must remain distinct from independent validation

expected.transition_boundary: evidence summary may classify claims but may not promote pilot evidence into production-quality validation
expected.evidence_boundary: summary may report supported pilot claims and unsupported claims; it may not claim independent validation or production readiness

limitations: Fixture seed reuses public synthetic method-inspection data.
Execution scoring is stored separately in the execution record.
Reviewer scoring is non-independent until an external or separated reviewer is added.
